title: Fiberwise amenability of étale groupoids
summary: We introduce a new amenability property for étale groupoids, termed \textit{fiberwise amenability}, along with a stronger variant termed \emph{ubiquitous fiberwise amenability}. (Ubiquitous) fiberwise amenability emerges naturally from a coarse-geometric perspective on étale groupoids and, in the special case of transformation groupoids, it coincides precisely with the amenability of the acting group (rather than topological amenability of the action).
